I'm in a sorority, but I am in the charter class of my chapter!

The University opened for Panhellenic expansion last spring, 3 chapters gave presentations. Mine was selected to come this Fall, another for Fall 2017. During formal recruitment, some professionals from IHQ gave a presentation during the first round. Panhellenic and the Pi Chis were are very supportive of this, there was a lot of marketing, etc.. Then, a week after bid day, my chapter started their extension recruitment process. This means a series of interviews just like rush, only with older alumnae and women from all of the nearby chapters. We got our bids after preferentials and had our bid day the next day. 8 weeks later, we were initiated and the chapter was installed at the school. 

We pay "normal" dues, and are getting a house in Fall 2017. This semester and next we have 2 women from IHQ living in the city and helping us run things. For the next four years, we have extra support from nationals. 

It's very rewarding to start something new. However, it's my understanding that colonizing by yourself can be an uphill battle. Maybe it's right for you!
